limited_overlap.description: applicants with prior earnings of at least 40,000 dollars: 3205 of 12000 program-year applicants, 36 of them enrolled (1.1%). Their effects are extrapolated from enrolled applicants with lower prior earnings.

537 of 4000 test applicants (13.4%) have a training-model enrolment probability below 0.02; 100% of them have prior earnings at or above 40,000 dollars. No training applicant with a comparable profile was enrolled often enough to measure their effect.
